# Anti-fabrication checklist
Never invent numbers, names, or quantities not present in the source.
Never drop content present in the source without a clear formatting reason.

This is about content, not sentence shape: restructuring word order, splitting or joining clauses, or moving a preverb for natural Hungarian focus (see lang-style.md) is not fabrication or dropped content as long as the same information survives. Judge by meaning preserved, not by how closely the sentence structure mirrors the source.
